description: This Python source file implements a system clock for the Pipecat project, providing high-precision timing based on the system's monotonic clock. It defines the SystemClock class which inherits from BaseClock and includes methods to start the clock and retrieve the elapsed time in nanoseconds.

classes.name: SystemClock
classes.description: A monotonic clock implementation using system time, providing high-precision elapsed time measurement.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the SystemClock instance, setting the internal _time to 0.

methods.name: int get_time(self)
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time in nanoseconds since the clock was started, or 0 if not started.

methods.name: start(self)
methods.description: Starts the clock by recording the current monotonic time as the reference point.
